name: compute_offset_and_restore_state
description: Calls two helpers, saves two 32-bit state values, then sets two state values from a table value plus 14000 (or 16000 when a flag is zero) before calling two more helpers and restoring the saved values.

name: run_steps_then_close_file
description: Saves a state variable and runs eight helper steps that must each return a non-negative value; on success it calls the DOS close handler and returns its result, otherwise it closes and returns minus one.

name: process_command_codes_until_done
description: Reads codes from a helper until it returns a negative value; code 12345 saves and restores a word in the record, codes 2 to 4 trigger an extra helper call, and every other code runs two helpers.

name: fill_four_by_sixteen_table
description: Fills a 64-entry table of 32-bit values arranged as four rows of sixteen, where each entry is its row index times four plus a 16-bit value read from a source table by column.

name: save_pair_then_invoke_routine
description: Copies the two incoming register arguments into globals and then calls one helper routine.

name: record_arguments_and_close_file
description: Saves two incoming arguments into globals and runs a helper; a nonzero result is recorded and a second helper's result is returned after closing the file through the DOS library, while a zero result calls another library routine and returns zero.

name: load_and_merge_bitmap_planes
description: Reads tagged records from a file with DOS read and seek calls: tag 3 unpacks nibble-packed pixels, tag 4 stores state, and tag 5 allocates bitmap plane descriptors with the graphics library. A final pass ORs four plane buffers word by word into one destination.

name: or_four_planes_into_target
description: Reads a stored bitplane descriptor from the context block and, when present, ORs four source plane buffers word by word into the destination plane, using a count derived from a width field and a row count.

name: find_iff_chunk_index
description: Scans up to six four-byte entries in a table and compares each with a four-byte tag at a given address, returning the matching index or minus one. The table holds IFF chunk identifiers such as BMHD, CMAP, GRAB and BODY.

name: loop_four_steps_per_row
description: Runs a counted loop calling four helper routines per pass, plus a fifth when a mode global exceeds four.

name: unpack_packbits_or_copy_words
description: Copies a compressed stream into a buffer: when a mode byte is set it decodes PackBits-style runs, where positive control bytes copy literal bytes and negative ones repeat the next byte, and otherwise it copies 16-bit words straight through.

name: set_flag_if_enabled
description: Tests an enable global; when it is zero it runs one helper, otherwise it sets a byte flag to one and runs the helper. The referenced text is a cockpit artwork path.

name: advance_offset_after_helper
description: Calls one helper, then increases a 32-bit offset global by 116. The referenced text is a cockpit artwork path.

name: fill_byte_and_word_outputs
description: Repeatedly calls a helper and writes its byte result to two destination pointers in a counted loop, then writes its word result to two further pointers in an endless loop with no exit.

name: clear_bitmap_and_set_planes
description: Clears the bitmap through the graphics library, then, when a size value is positive, stores five plane addresses into a structure, each one a stride further than the previous, and returns zero; otherwise it returns minus one.

name: setup_graphics_view_and_viewport
description: Initialises a 320-pixel-wide display: it allocates a colour map, sets up the view, viewport and raster port, loads the view and merges the copper list, then sets the stored height to 200 and the stride to 8000.

name: reconfigure_existing_display_view
description: Reconfigures a 320-pixel-wide display view, allocating a colour map only on first use, updating the height global, rebuilding the viewport and raster port, then loading the view and merging the copper list.

name: set_mode_one_reload_view
description: Sets a field to minus one, calls a helper, then records mode one with a height of 5 and runs make-viewport, merge-copper and load-view steps from the graphics library.

name: set_mode_zero_load_view
description: Records mode zero with a height of 4 and loads the view through the graphics library.

name: update_frame_delta_and_flip
description: Stores the current counter value, clamps its difference from the previous value to between 8 and 50, then flips a double-buffer flag and swaps two pointer pairs to alternate between two buffers.

name: reload_view_and_clear_flag
description: Calls one helper, reloads the view through the graphics library, then clears a byte flag.

name: copy_display_state_and_reload
description: Copies four saved display values into a second set of globals, calls one helper, runs one of two helper pairs chosen by a flag, then frees copper lists, waits for the bottom of the viewport, reloads the view and calls four more helpers.

name: reset_viewport_and_save_values
description: Clears two pointer globals and two values, rebuilds the viewport and merges the copper list through the graphics library, then copies the two values into a second pair of globals.

name: reset_viewport_into_second_pair
description: Clears two pointer globals and two values, rebuilds the viewport and merges the copper list through the graphics library, then copies the two values into a different pair of globals.

name: rebuild_view_when_values_change
description: Saves two state values, runs a sequence of graphics library view steps that rebuild the viewport and copper list, then frees a copper list only when the saved values differ from the stored ones.

name: poll_key_dispatch_loop
description: Runs a per-tick loop that, every eighth tick when a condition holds, calls helpers, then reads an event code and dispatches on it: letter and digit codes call helpers and set mode fields, the code for q returns minus one, and the space code sets an output.

name: clear_flag_run_four_steps
description: Clears a 32-bit global, then calls four helper routines in sequence.

name: forward_registers_to_helper
description: Calls one helper, then calls another helper with the incoming register values passed through, and returns the register pair unchanged.

name: sum_bytes_in_fixed_range
description: Adds up every byte from a fixed start address to a fixed end address in the program and returns the total.

name: store_helper_result_in_field
description: Calls one helper and stores its 32-bit result in a field of the context block.

name: poll_key_dispatch_until_changed
description: Calls a helper and returns its value at once if it matches a stored value; otherwise it runs the same per-tick event dispatch as the neighbouring routine, where letter and digit codes set mode fields and the code for q returns minus one.

name: return_without_action
description: Contains no operations and returns at once.

name: store_constant_into_global
description: Stores one fixed 32-bit constant in a global variable and returns.

name: check_disk_swap_state
description: Clears a status word, compares a value read from a helper with a stored reference, and when they differ calls helpers, reads again and sets the status word to minus one if they still differ. The referenced text prompts the user to insert the original or back-up disk in drive A.

name: run_two_helper_steps
description: Calls two helper routines in sequence and returns.

name: run_helper_when_timer_elapsed
description: When a count is positive, a field is set, no busy flag is raised and a timer has advanced by at least 40 units (or a force flag is set), it records the current counter, sets a busy flag around one helper call, and clears it afterwards.

name: call_single_helper_and_return
description: Calls one helper routine and returns without other work.

name: copy_indexed_word_to_field
description: Reads an index from a context field, uses it to look up a 16-bit value in a global table, and stores that value in another field of the context block.

name: delegate_to_single_helper
description: Calls one helper routine and returns.

name: copy_indexed_word_to_field
description: Reads an index from a context field, uses it to look up a 16-bit value in a global table, and stores that value in another field of the context block.

name: store_three_offset_values
description: Calls a helper three times and stores each result, reduced by 256, into three consecutive word fields of the context block.

name: advance_seed_and_scale
description: Advances a 16-bit seed with a multiply-by-31415 and add-one step, then returns the low 15 bits of the seed multiplied by the input value and doubled, keeping the high word.

name: call_library_with_clamped_offset
description: When a flag is zero, calls a helper, clamps a stored value to between minus five and five, passes it with fixed numeric parameters to a library routine, then calls that library routine again.

name: call_helper_with_swapped_buffers
description: Temporarily replaces two buffer pointers with an alternate pair, calls one helper, then restores the original pointers.

name: blit_fixed_rectangle_bitmap
description: Calls one helper, then runs a bitmap blit through the graphics library with fixed dimensions and a fixed mask value, and calls the library again to finish.

name: iterate_linked_entries_with_helper
description: Sets a timing field to 200, then, when two status flags are clear, walks a linked list of entries and calls a helper with fixed arguments for each one, and finally sets the timing field to 150.

name: run_helper_for_each_count
description: Sets a status field to zero, points a buffer pointer at a global for the duration, calls one helper once per count from a field value down to zero, restores the pointer and sets the status field to 19.

name: return_without_action
description: Contains no operations and returns at once.

name: compute_integer_square_root
description: Returns the integer square root of a non-negative 32-bit input, found by a bit-by-bit search that keeps each candidate whose square does not exceed the input.

name: return_without_action
description: Contains no operations and returns at once.

name: return_without_action
description: Contains no operations and returns at once.

name: send_serial_byte_when_ready
description: Waits until a busy flag is clear, sets it to minus one, then writes the low byte of the input with bit eight set to the serial data register.

name: enable_serial_interrupts_with_flag
description: Writes 1 to one hardware register, clears a flag, then writes 32769 (the set bit plus bit 0) to the interrupt-enable register.

name: initialise_serial_port_settings
description: Writes 185 to the serial period register and to a status copy, clears several context fields, then writes an interrupt-enable value with the set bit.

name: handle_serial_receive_interrupt
description: Interrupt handler for received serial bytes: outside command mode it appends the byte to an 80-entry ring buffer; in command mode it subtracts 42 from the byte, looks up a table entry and updates command state, then writes a fixed status value.

name: store_word_and_write_status
description: Stores the incoming 16-bit argument in a context field and writes the fixed value 34816 to a hardware register.

name: decode_serial_command_byte
description: Subtracts 42 from a received byte, looks it up in a table of 32 entries, sets context fields to record a valid command or an error, then writes a fixed status value to a hardware register.

name: reset_serial_command_state
description: Clears three context fields, sets another to minus one, and writes a fixed status value to a hardware register.

name: append_serial_byte_to_buffer
description: Stores the received byte at the current position of an 80-entry buffer, advances the position with wraparound, then writes a fixed status value to a hardware register.

name: check_serial_buffer_pending
description: Returns minus one when the read index and the write index differ and zero when they are equal, reporting whether unread bytes remain.

name: read_serial_byte_from_buffer
description: Busy-waits until the read index differs from the write index, returns the byte at the read index of an 80-entry buffer, and advances the read index with wraparound.

name: clear_pending_flags_in_mode
description: When a mode field is set, clears a pending flag and returns if it was set; otherwise it runs one helper (with two extra helpers when a secondary field is set) and clears a second flag.

name: parse_serial_packet_with_timeouts
description: Receives a command over the serial link: it reads a length-prefixed run of bytes into a buffer with every wait bounded by a timeout counter, and for command 3 it initialises several context fields. A timeout writes a fixed status value and returns the result of a helper.

name: poll_until_helper_returns_zero
description: Calls a helper up to 41 times, stopping early the first time it returns zero, and calls a second helper after each nonzero result.

name: send_characters_with_flag_wait
description: Copies the current character into a context field, adds 42 to it in place, then waits for a flag before each of a counted number of helper calls, and calls two more helpers when a field is nonzero.

name: fill_bytes_until_limit
description: Writes a context byte into a destination pointer one step at a time, calling a helper per byte and moving to the next 80-byte row, until a computed limit is reached or a state byte equals four.

name: set_mode_four_and_run
description: Sets a global variable to four and calls one helper routine.

name: dispatch_state_code_handlers
description: Dispatches on a state byte: code 3 starts a sequence, code 15 copies a nine-entry block between buffers and stores a mode, code 7 stores a word field, and other codes call helpers. The result is returned from the chosen branch.

name: copy_context_fields_to_globals
description: Stores a mode byte of 1, or 11 when either of two fields is nonzero, then copies six context fields into global variables and calls one helper.

name: run_helper_until_timeout_marker
description: Clears a field while running a helper, then repeatedly calls another helper until a status byte equals 24 or a window of 800 time units elapses, and restores the field.

name: start_timed_sequence_mode
description: Clears a field and copies values from a linked structure into globals, sets a mode byte to 26 and a timing value to 2400, calls a helper, then sets a field to minus one and restores the saved field.

name: copy_nine_bytes_when_negative
description: When a field is negative, copies nine bytes from a fixed table into a global buffer. The referenced text lists surnames.

name: toggle_mode_by_status_flag
description: When a status field is nonzero, it sets a mode code of 29, clears related fields and calls helpers; otherwise it runs helpers and, when a result is non-negative, sets a mode field and a flag to one.

name: read_text_until_period
description: Reads characters with a timeout until a period arrives, copies a nine-byte field, then keeps reading until a code of 16 is seen and copies the name bytes into a second buffer. It returns minus one on timeout.

name: wait_twelve_frames
description: Calls a graphics library routine twelve times, each call waiting for the next top-of-frame event.

name: return_without_action
description: Contains no operations and returns at once.

name: compute_clamped_distance
description: Takes the high byte of a context field, makes it absolute, and returns sixty minus that value (or zero when it exceeds sixty) after calling one helper.

name: update_object_motion_state
description: Updates one object record each tick: adds a helper value to a coordinate, steps the position by per-axis velocities until a counter reaches its limit, and calls helpers to finish the frame.

name: initialise_object_random_offsets
description: On first use, marks an object record active, sets two speed fields to 10 and 20, clears three counters, and sets three coordinates from helper values reduced by 64.

name: initialise_object_fixed_offsets
description: On first use, marks an object record active, sets two speed fields to 10 and 20, clears three counters, and sets three coordinates to minus 80, zero and zero.

name: initialise_object_velocity_by_flags
description: Sets an object record's timing and velocity fields, negating the x and y velocities when bit one of a flag word is clear and the other velocity components when bit two is clear.

name: initialise_object_random_position
description: On first use, marks an object record active, sets three coordinates from helper values reduced by 255, and sets a direction field derived from a fourth helper value.

name: update_timer_status_flags
description: Advances two counters by 3 and 7 each tick and sets status bits 32, 16 and 8 when the counters reach a limit taken from a record field, then calls two helpers.

name: activate_object_record
description: Marks a new object record as unused with minus one, clears a counter, calls helpers, sets an active field to one, links the record into the list and calls one more helper.

name: scale_table_entries_into_outputs
description: Scales two table values with multiply and divide steps and stores each result, offset by a base field, into two output tables.

name: fill_projection_tables_once
description: On first call, fills per-row tables: for each row it stores three values reduced by 63 and writes constant fields, then fills a further table with values offset by 23.

name: update_projected_point_positions
description: Updates a list of points each frame: for each active point it adds a step from one table to its position, decrements its counter, and writes results to output tables while tracking a remaining count in a field.

name: update_entry_arrays_per_frame
description: Advances a field by 200, then loops over up to 800 entries; for entries whose value is negative it stores a byte, computes new values from helper results and scaled table products, and writes them into parallel arrays while recording the highest index reached.

name: select_helper_byte_by_flag
description: Calls two helpers, then stores a byte returned by a helper into a context byte, choosing between two helper calls based on whether a field is zero.

name: advance_active_entry_tables
description: Calls helpers and, when a counter is under 40, may call further helpers; then loops over an array of counters, moving paired pointers by fixed steps of 14 for nonnegative counters and decrementing each counter.

name: reset_table_and_deadline
description: Clears a counter, sets 501 entries of a table to minus one, zeroes two fields, and sets a time limit three thousand units ahead of the current counter.

name: wait_three_frames
description: Calls the graphics library wait-for-frame routine three times.

name: run_clamped_update_until_input
description: Runs a 200-step update loop that clamps several counters between bounds and calls helpers every eighth step, then scans up to 200 rows and exits early when a character is read; it finally sets two display fields to 160 and 100.

name: reset_rotation_matrix_identity
description: Sets fixed-point matrix entries to 16384 at fixed positions and zero elsewhere, giving the starting matrix.

name: rotate_matrix_pair_forward
description: Calls a helper and saves two values, then combines fixed-point matrix entries with the saved pair to compute six new entries, and copies a nine-word working block into the stored matrix.

name: rotate_matrix_pair_reverse
description: Calls a helper and saves two values, then recomputes six matrix entries from products of the saved pair with the first value negated, and copies the nine-word working block into the stored matrix.

name: rotate_matrix_pair_with_shift
description: Calls a helper and saves two values, recomputes six matrix entries as products of the saved pair and stored entries, copies three entries directly, then copies the nine-word working block into the stored matrix.

name: test_point_against_planes
description: Tests a point against up to four planes of a stored list: it returns the index of the first plane whose dot product exceeds 99 with a minus-one marker, or otherwise the index and value of the qualifying plane.

name: resolve_object_collision_response
description: Resets object state fields, computes a separation vector and its squared length, and when the length is nonzero scales a velocity correction by a field and applies it to the object, storing results in several arrays.

name: check_point_within_plane_limits
description: Checks a point against the four planes of one list entry; it returns minus one when every plane's dot product exceeds 99, otherwise the index of the first plane not exceeded, with zero or minus one as the secondary result.

name: wait_for_event_until_deadline
description: When two status fields are clear and a third is set, sets a deadline 2600 units ahead and calls a helper in a loop until the deadline passes or an event code is seen; it then clears a flag and sets a marker when a field is nonzero.

name: reset_state_and_fill_tables
description: Resets many state fields and clears a 174-word table, then fills 40 rows of paired table entries from helper results, negating one entry of each pair.

name: initialise_object_record_fields
description: Resets a long list of fields in an object record, including positions, counters, timers and pointers, then calls helpers to set up table entries for the record.

name: switch_buffer_and_run_steps
description: Points a buffer pointer at a stored field, calls one helper, switches it to an alternate global buffer, then calls seven more helpers.

name: run_seven_steps_then_stamp
description: Calls one helper seven times, records the current counter in a timing field, then calls one helper twice.

name: set_fields_from_table_index
description: Copies a timing value into a field, computes a table offset for the current index with wraparound, and sets several derived fields from it, including a shifted copy and a half-value.

name: set_table_values_by_sign
description: Chooses one of two fixed sets of values based on a sign flag, writing four table words and three paired counters accordingly.

name: call_helpers_with_swapped_pointers
description: When a flag is negative, saves two buffer pointers, swaps in a fixed buffer, calls helpers with a value of 150 and a value of 319, and restores the saved pointers.

name: clear_text_and_reset_timer
description: Fills six character cells with spaces, calls one helper, increments a counter, and sets status fields and a deadline 180000 units ahead of the current counter.

name: build_linked_object_list
description: Resets state fields, then builds a linked list of six entries, writing for each one a link value, a table value reduced by the previous entry, a flag and a helper result.

name: initialise_linked_entry_values
description: Resets several state fields, then walks the linked entry list setting each entry's index, a table value adjusted by a constant when negative, a flag and a helper result.

name: run_state_update_loop
description: Loops over update steps for the current state, calling about thirty helpers, handling timed flags and a per-entry queue, and returns a combined 32-bit result once a stop condition is met.

name: run_result_screen_loop
description: Runs a large update loop that resets per-frame fields, performs helper steps and chooses which screen messages to show. The referenced text includes a results heading and position labels.

name: record_best_entry_name
description: Scans the linked entry list for the smallest stored value; if it beats the stored best for the current slot, copies that entry's ten-byte name into a table and sets a flag.

name: copy_name_when_value_improves
description: Uses a pre-selected entry to update the stored best value for the current slot, and when the new value is lower copies its ten-byte name into a table and sets a flag.

name: stub_empty_decompile_body
description: The decompiler output for this routine has no statements, although the listing shows about ten calls, so no behaviour can be stated from the code.

name: run_three_helpers_when_idle
description: When two status fields are clear, calls three helpers; the same three calls run on both branches of a flag test, which a second field controls.

name: run_two_helpers_when_idle
description: When four status fields are all zero, calls two helpers; the referenced text labels a lead timer.

name: advance_timer_by_fifteen
description: Calls two helpers, then increases a timer value by 15. The referenced text includes labels for lap times and breakdowns.

name: toggle_flag_and_run_steps
description: Complements a 16-bit flag word, then runs a loop of helper steps that ends when a state field is zero and a counter is set, returning a combined 32-bit value.

name: copy_entry_words_into_table
description: Walks the linked entry list for up to six entries, copying each entry's first word into a row of a table selected by a counter and adding a stored delta to a second field; then it increments the counter.

name: update_frame_motion_state
description: Performs a large per-frame update of motion fields: when a flag is set it clears several state words and returns early, otherwise it derives speed and position values from stored fields and calls helpers to write the results.

name: wrap_heading_angle_and_store
description: When a field is nonzero, updates two fields by stored increments chosen by a mode, wraps an angle field back into range by adding or subtracting 360, stores the results and calls helpers.

name: store_wrapped_heading_pair
description: Wraps a heading value into range by 360, stores it with a second value into two sets of fields, then calls helpers and combines a table entry with a stored factor.

name: store_heading_pair_low_wrap
description: Wraps a heading value that is below minus 359 by adding 360, stores it with a second value into two sets of fields, then calls helpers and combines a table entry with a stored factor.

name: update_audio_channel_volumes
description: Sets two audio channel volume values to 40 or 60 depending on a flag, adjusts a level by a stored step for each channel, and writes the results to the audio volume registers.

name: set_audio_period_from_pitch
description: Computes an audio period from a table value and a stored pitch, adds a fixed offset and clamps the result between 300 and 810, then writes it to the audio period registers.

name: step_values_by_status_bits
description: Clears two state words, then steps two values by amounts scaled from a limit of 175 and 125 minus their magnitudes, choosing directions from bits of a status byte and setting an update flag.

name: read_joystick_direction_bits
description: Decodes the joystick port movement and fire-button register images into a status byte that packs four direction bits and a button bit, and stores it in a context field.

name: fill_record_table_with_values
description: Initialises two fields to 32000, then loops over a record table writing computed entries into it. The referenced text is a label reading NUMBER.

name: update_audio_channel_two
description: Loops over stored sound entries, advancing a pointer by 95 words per entry and writing period and volume values to the audio channel two registers, with a timing check on each step.

name: advance_record_counter_on_timeout
description: When 400 time units have passed since a record's stored time, advances the record's counter; when the count is positive it sets a bit in a mask, updates the record's timing and calls helpers.

name: update_speed_and_distance_values
description: Calls helpers for each frame update, then adjusts a counter by a term derived from a stored value and a multiplier, stepping two offset fields when a difference passes a threshold.

name: advance_countdown_state
description: Returns early when a flag is set; otherwise it runs a helper on a 60-tick cadence and, in state six, waits up to 1000 time units before advancing the state, while other states step a counter and call helpers.

name: set_state_wait_for_clear
description: When a state field is zero, runs a helper with a timing value of 800; then waits until another field is zero, stores a state code of 27 and calls a helper.

name: update_position_and_lead_displays
description: Compares two stored values against a band of 180 to 224 to show or hide markers, then updates the lead and position text through helpers. The referenced text includes labels for lead and positions.

name: call_helper_and_return_pair
description: Calls one helper and returns the register pair unchanged.

name: offset_fields_around_helper_calls
description: Saves two position fields, calls four helpers, adds to each field a helper value reduced by 24, calls two more helpers, then restores the saved fields.

name: call_helper_then_optional_second
description: Calls a helper, then calls another helper when a flag is set and the high word of the result is positive; the original result is returned unchanged.

name: start_timed_event_once
description: On first trigger, sets a counter, sends a code of 12 through a helper when a field is positive, and sets a deadline 5000 units ahead of the current counter before calling a helper.

name: reset_timers_with_deadline
description: Resets timer and counter fields, computes a deadline from a table value scaled by five plus a helper value scaled by four, and sets a flag when a table byte is nonzero.

name: clear_timers_and_send_code
description: When a field is positive, sends a code of 13 through a helper, then sets two timers to minus one, another field to minus 15 and clears a flag.

name: run_frame_with_display_waits
description: Runs a per-frame update that, when a field is set, updates a counter and a timing value and calls helpers, then reloads the view and waits for the blitter and video frame through the graphics library. The referenced text includes a PIT STOP label.

name: return_stack_value_after_helper
description: Calls a helper and returns the 64-bit value held on the stack unchanged.

name: compute_point_difference_tables
description: Clears three accumulator fields, then fills tables of point coordinates and their differences from the previous point, looping over a fixed count of points.

name: compute_face_normal_components
description: Computes the cross product of two edge vectors built from three stored points, scales each component and divides it by a magnitude from a helper, then stores the three normal components.

name: accumulate_difference_quotients
description: When a flag is zero, sets a constant of 128 and clears two fields, computes sequential differences of stored values, then loops calling a helper and accumulating quotient values into fields.

name: scale_record_values_by_speed
description: Derives a speed value from a table entry and a stored flag, defaulting to 3000 when zero, then writes a clamped adjusted field into each record of a list, advancing 190 bytes per record.

name: reset_state_from_saved_positions
description: Sets a status word to minus one, clears a global, loads three position values from tables into fields with their negatives in a second set, and copies several saved state values from a context block.

name: call_helper_mark_minus_one
description: Calls one helper and sets a status word to minus one.

name: save_state_into_context_block
description: Clears two state words, copies seven stored values into the context block, and copies several table pointers into saved fields, with helper calls for the sizes.

name: return_without_action
description: Contains no operations and returns at once.

name: return_without_action
description: Contains no operations and returns at once.

name: stub_empty_decompile_body
description: The decompiler output for this routine has no statements, although the listing shows many instructions, so no behaviour can be stated from the code.

name: shift_pairs_down_one_slot
description: Shifts pairs of 32-bit values in a table down by one slot, copying the first pair into the vacated end, using a count taken from a field minus one.

name: write_position_label_and_name
description: Writes a digit character for the given index, copies the ten-byte name stored for that index into a text buffer, and appends a space.

name: format_lap_time_with_name
description: Copies the ten-byte name for an index into a text record, then formats a stored time value, halved, as minutes, seconds and hundredths, writing the digits and separators into the record.

name: blit_glyph_into_bitplane
description: Looks up a glyph pattern from a table and writes its bits into the bitplane over eight rows, shifting each row across words and combining with existing pixels under bit masks taken from a mode word.

name: write_lap_separator_markers
description: Writes a marker character for each lap entry up to a stored count, for at most four entries, then sets an indicator byte to three. The referenced text includes a lap times heading.

name: copy_field_and_advance_offset
description: Copies one 16-bit field into another and increases a third field by six.

name: format_average_lap_time
description: Calculates an average value from a stored total and a lap count, then writes it as digits into a text line, looping over up to twelve character cells. The referenced text includes AVERAGE LAP and LAP TIMES labels.

name: format_digits_or_blank
description: Writes six digit characters from a stored value when it is non-negative and below a limit; otherwise it writes six spaces into the same cells.

name: copy_nine_bytes_then_call
description: Copies nine bytes from a source pointer into a global buffer, then calls one helper.

name: format_two_digit_number
description: Formats a value modulo 100 as two digits, leaving the tens place blank when it is zero, writes them into a text buffer, then writes five more digits from stored bytes.

name: split_time_into_digit_bytes
description: Splits a time value, halved, into minute, second and hundredth digit bytes stored in global variables.

name: format_elapsed_time_line
description: Returns early when two fields show it should stay hidden; otherwise it stores four column positions, computes the time elapsed since a stored start counter, halved, and writes its digits into the text buffer.

name: return_without_action
description: Contains no operations and returns at once.

name: run_pair_alternate_buffer
description: When a field is nonzero or a flag is zero, points a buffer pointer at each of two buffers in turn, calls one helper for each, and restores the original pointer.

name: write_lap_count_field
description: Sets four column positions and writes a two-digit value derived from a counter, showing the tens digit only when it is nonzero, then calls two helpers.

name: write_lap_number_labels
description: Walks the linked entry list, writing for each entry a short label from a table and its lap number plus one as two digits into a text buffer, stopping after 23 characters. The referenced text is a NO. LAP heading.

name: compute_gap_to_leader_times
description: Finds the smallest stored time among list entries other than a reserved one, then gives each entry either a sentinel of 65000 or its difference from the leader scaled by 250, and calls a helper when done.

name: write_entry_name_and_gap
description: Finds the list entry whose identifier matches a key and returns minus one when none matches; otherwise it writes its position digit and name into a text line and formats its gap, showing dashes when the gap is the sentinel.

name: cycle_entry_name_display
description: Advances a rotating index through the entry list, wrapping after one more than the list length, then writes that entry's position digit and name into a text line, using dashes for a sentinel gap. Returns minus one if no entry matches. The referenced text is a QUALIFYING label.

name: advance_stored_entry_index
description: Advances a stored index to the next entry plus one, wrapping to zero at the list limit, stores a value from that entry and sets two status words to minus one and zero.

name: format_signed_time_difference
description: Writes a plus or minus sign depending on whether the list head is the reserved entry, then writes a name table code and a time value divided by 20 as digits with a decimal point.

name: compare_adjacent_entry_keys
description: Repeatedly computes a combined key for adjacent pairs of entries in the linked list and compares them, using coordinates or a stored value depending on a flag.

name: record_timing_or_schedule_next
description: Records the current counter when an index is non-negative; when a flag is set it clears two fields, calls a helper with a sentinel index, sets a flag to minus one and computes a deadline from a stored speed value; otherwise it clears a field pair and calls a helper.

name: sort_linked_entries_by_key
description: Repeatedly walks the linked entry list and moves an entry ahead of its predecessor when its stored key is smaller, relinking neighbours until no exchanges remain, and returns the number of exchanges.

name: update_entry_positions
description: Updates each list entry's position from indexed table values and a stored offset, using helper results for timing, with the segment index advanced and wrapped at the list length.

name: trigger_key_event_once
description: When two flags are clear and a table byte is not positive, checks a key code of 16 and a timing value to decide whether to call a helper once and set a latch flag, clearing another latch when the key code differs.

name: dispatch_by_state_value
description: Calls one helper when a state value is three, another when it is not one, and a third when it is one.

name: forward_to_single_helper
description: Calls one helper routine and returns without other work.

name: run_timed_update_step
description: Runs one step of a timed update, skipped when flags are set; otherwise it updates a counter and table values and calls seven helpers. The referenced text includes a QUALIFYING label.

name: update_messages_and_positions
description: Resets two fields and computes a timed value; depending on lead and status checks, it calls helpers that update positions and show waiting or warning messages.

name: update_entry_order_and_positions
description: Computes per-entry values and positions over the entry arrays in a loop, storing results through nine helper calls and updating several fields.

name: set_audio_volumes_and_wait
description: Computes levels for all four audio channels and writes them to the volume registers through helpers. The referenced text is a PLEASE WAIT prompt.

name: load_position_from_table_index
description: Calls a helper, then loads three values from tables indexed by a counter into position fields, stores their negatives in a second set, and clears a group of state words.

name: clear_state_fields
description: Clears twelve context fields to zero.

name: offset_fields_by_half_input
description: Adds half of its input to two position fields computed from helper results, calls two helpers, then restores the saved fields.

name: update_eight_segment_positions
description: Loops over eight segments, copying a block of eight table entries and calling helpers for each segment, using a stored position value to set a per-segment offset.

name: load_segment_values_by_index
description: Clears a field and loads positions for the current index from tables, adding ten to one coordinate, then calls helpers that store the resulting position values.

name: increment_counter_and_run_steps
description: Increments a 32-bit counter, then calls helpers, with extra helper calls when a status bit or a field is set.

name: clear_pair_between_helper_calls
description: Calls helpers, clears two 16-bit fields, then calls five more helpers.

name: combine_helper_values_into_result
description: Calls five helpers and combines their 32-bit results arithmetically to produce the routine's return value.

name: wait_for_sound_data_ready
description: Sets several timing and sound fields, then polls a helper for up to 12000 time units until it reports ready or a flag clears, and then halts in an endless loop. The referenced text names a sounds data file.

name: reset_game_state_and_wait
description: Resets many state words and selects a mode by a flag, calls about thirty helpers, and waits for a top-of-frame event through the graphics library while setting up the next state.

name: call_three_helpers_in_order
description: Calls three helper routines in sequence and returns.

name: advance_stage_after_threshold
description: Adds two stored values and compares the sum with a threshold; when it is reached, advances a stage counter, and at stage four runs a set of helper calls that reset flags.

name: compute_ratio_and_copy_block
description: Computes a fixed-point ratio of two input values and stores it in a field, then copies an eight-word block between two stored blocks and calls helpers.

name: next_index_with_wrap
description: Returns the input plus one, or zero when that reaches the limit held in a context field.
